what: a triangle sharing the cylinder side and top rim revolved as a cut to leave a cone (the cut never completed)
method: the triangle (20,0) (20,30) (0,30) revolved about the cylinder axis removes everything outside the cone from the apex (0,0,30) to the base rim r 20 at z = 0: V = pi 20^2 30 / 3, A = base pi 20^2 + lateral pi 20 sqrt(20^2 + 30^2); faces: cone and base disc.
